_comment: Required status checks for `main`, versioned so the set is reviewed in a PR rather than remembered. Apply with `make branch-protection-apply` (owner; needs repo admin). `make branch-protection-show` diffs this file against the live setting. Context names are the CI job `name:` values in .github/workflows/ci.yml plus the commitlint job.
_not_required_comment: CI jobs that run on every pull request and that `main` does not require, each with its reason. A job in ci.yml must be in `contexts` or here, so a job that can merge red is a recorded choice. To require one, move its name to `contexts` and apply. None today: `Python 3.12 (unit tests)` was named here from ISSUE-0219 until ruling (ab) of the sequencing Amendment 2026-11-28 moved it to `contexts`, after 64 green runs.
